title: Profiles: the right access for the work in hand
summary: See your master profile, make smaller profiles for a region, a state and a county, and switch between them.

steps.say: Sky works for EPA Region 3. The profile box in the header shows the profile in use: right now, the master profile.
onScreen: Profile · Master profile · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction

steps.say: Work queues shows tasks from every state in the region, from Delaware to West Virginia.
onScreen: Select all on this page · Task · ⇅ · Queue · ⇅ · Person Case Due · ▲ · Assigned · Select row 1 · Delaware: follow up an elevated child result in Kent County Action level follow-up · Select row 2 · Pennsylvania: contact a Philadelphia family Action level follow-up · Select row 3 · Harford County: schedule a home visit in Bel Air Action level follow-up · Select row 4 · Maryland: confirm a venous res

steps.say: Select the profile box to open My profiles.
actions: Selects “Profile Master profile Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”

steps.say: The master profile is everything your administrator gave you: Supervisor at EPA Region 3 and everything under it.
onScreen: Master profile Master · Everything you have been given. Managed by your administrator. · Supervisor at EPA Region 3 and everything under it · Full (read, write and delete) · In use

steps.say: A profile is a smaller copy of it, like a day key cut from a master key. It can open fewer doors, never more.
First, a profile that sees every state in the region but cannot change anything, for reviews and screen sharing.
actions: Types “Region 3, all states (read only)” in Name

steps.say: Each grant is a place, a role and an access level. Choose EPA Region 3, and keep everything under it.
Set the access to read only.
Beside the form is your master profile, the most a profile can have. MERIT refuses to save one that goes beyond it.
onScreen: Your master profile · This is the most you can have. A profile can be smaller, never bigger: MERIT refuses to save one that goes beyond it. · Supervisor at EPA Region 3 and everything under it · Full (read, write and delete)

steps.say: Save the profile.
Next, a profile for all of Maryland.
Choose Maryland as the place. Everything under it, including Harford County, comes with it.
Read and write without delete lets you work normally while protecting records from being deleted.
actions: Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: Last, a profile for a day of Harford County work.
Choose the Harford County Health Department, with full access, and save.
actions: Chooses “Harford County Health Department” for Place
Chooses “Full (read, write and delete)” for Access

steps.say: My profiles now lists the master profile and the three new ones, each with what it gives you.
onScreen: Profile What it gives you · Actions · Master profile Master · Everything you have been given. Managed by your administrator. · Supervisor at EPA Region 3 and everything under it · Full (read, write and delete) · In use · Harford County only · Supervisor at Harford County Health Department and everything under it · Full (read, write and delete) · Use · Harford County only · Change · Harford County

steps.say: To switch, choose Use beside a profile. MERIT changes straight away, without signing out.
The header now shows Maryland only, and Work queues lists just the Maryland tasks, Harford County included.
onScreen: Profile · Maryland only · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction

Select all on this page · Task · ⇅ · Queue · ⇅ · Person Case Due · ▲ · Assigned · Select row 1 · Harford County: schedule a home visit in Bel Air Action level follow-up · Select row 2 · Maryland: confirm a venous result from Cecil County Action level follow-up

steps.say: Switch to Harford County only, and only the Harford County task is left.
actions: Selects “Profile Maryland only Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”
onScreen: Select all on this page · Task · ⇅ · Queue · ⇅ · Person Case Due · ▲ · Assigned · Select row 1 · Harford County: schedule a home visit in Bel Air Action level follow-up

steps.say: With the read-only regional profile, every state is back. Intake, which adds records, is gone from the menu.
actions: Selects “Profile Harford County only Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”
